summary: Milestone 2 Module 8 (Parent Academic Experience) end-to-end PASS. Backend: tests/test_m2_parent.py 1/1 passed (1.88s); full regression suite 94 passed + 1 skipped (41.46s) - zero regression across M1 + M2 attendance/staff/homework/diary/timetable/exams/workspace. Live GET /api/parent/children/{id}/overview on preview URL returns {date, attendance{today,month_rate,days,absent}, timetable_today[6 periods], homework{due_count,due_today,next}, diary_today, latest_result} with correct Class 1-A section data for parent@sunrise.demo (kids Aarav Pillai, Ishaan Das) and for multi.parent@schoolpulse.demo (Zara Chauhan in Sunrise). Access rules verified: teacher@sunrise.demo -> 403, parent@greenfield.demo -> 403 against sunrise child. UI (390x844, parent@sunrise.demo on live Expo preview): Family home shows 'Today at school' section with the overview card and all four tiles ov-attendance ('—Today · —% this month'), ov-homework ('1Homework due · 1 today'), ov-periods ('6Periods today'), ov-result ('—No results yet'); after seeding a TEST published homework due today + TEST diary entry as teacher@sunrise.demo (English for section 6ad09c1b1aad3ba7d4fb3a15 = Class 1-A) the ov-diary row ('Learnt today • English: TEST ov diary') appeared, and switching child via child-switcher-button -> child-option-<ishaanId> updated the card (same homework count for Ishaan since the hw was section-wide, before mark-done). Navigation tested: ov-homework -> /child-homework/<sid>?name=..., ov-periods -> /child-timetable/<sid>, ov-result -> /child-exams/<sid>, ov-diary -> /child-diary/<sid>. multi.parent@schoolpulse.demo -> select-school -> Sunrise -> Zara Chauhan card shows all tiles including ov-diary with seeded content. Regression on parent home: parent-welcome-banner, child-attendance-today/present, child-homework-card still render after returning. One MINOR duplicate testID detected: family.tsx line 106 renders the Student overview Card with testID='child-overview-card' AND the ChildOverview inner Card uses the same testID='child-overview-card' - two nodes resolve to the same selector (observed count=2 in query_selector_all).

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate testID 'child-overview-card' on the page: /app/frontend/app/(parent)/family.tsx:106 uses testID='child-overview-card' for the Student overview Card AND /app/frontend/src/components/child-overview.tsx:38 reuses the same testID. Two matching nodes exist on the DOM, which can break targeted queries. Rename the inner one (e.g., 'today-at-school-card') or the family.tsx one.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo web preview still logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' as cosmetic warnings (no behaviour impact). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card/IconTile shadow usage).

action_items: Rename the duplicate testID on either family.tsx:106 (Student overview Card) or child-overview.tsx:38 (Today at school Card) so each resolves to a unique node (minor polish only).
(Optional carry-over) Migrate deprecated RN style props shadow*->boxShadow and remove props.pointerEvents in ui.tsx to clean up Expo web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_parent.py (~43 LOC) is a single endpoint, scoped by need('parent.portal'); guardian verification uses the existing _parent_links helper and raises 403 if the student_id is not in the parent's verified set - teacher/other-family 403 verified live.

Homework 'pending' is correctly filtered: db.homework finds published docs with due_date >= today, then Python-level excludes any that already have completion[student_id]=='done'. Matches the test assertion that marking done drops due_count back to baseline.
Diary filter correctly scopes to the student's section_id and today's date (IST) and excludes deleted docs; subject_name resolution falls back to None when subject_id is missing (optional field).
attendance.month_rate is computed only when days>0, else None - safe divide. Response shape matches the frontend Overview type in child-overview.tsx exactly.
latest_result is derived from parent_exams(student_id)['items'][0], reusing an existing endpoint for consistency - no duplicate scoring logic.
child-overview.tsx wires useQuery with key ['parent-overview', school_id, studentId] so switching child invalidates and refetches - verified live when switching between Aarav and Ishaan.
No mongodb _id leaks in the response; all id fields are string-cast (homework.next[*].id). No DRY/async issues.
Nit: family.tsx has a duplicate testID 'child-overview-card' (two Card wrappers share the same id).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (tiles render, child switch refetches overview, all four navigation targets reached, diary row appears after seeding, legacy parent cards still work, multi-parent flow across schools works)
